entities.name: Citanul
entities.description: Capital of Argoth, a city built in harmony with nature and seat of the Court of Titania.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Queen who resided in Citanul and refused Harbin's alliance.

entities.name: Citanul Druids
entities.description: Order of druids descended from surviving Thran who disavowed technology.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Urza's envoy who crashed his thopter on Argoth.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother who activated the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact whose activation caused the Sylex Blast.

events.summary: Harbin crashes on Argoth; Gwenna sends word, but the Citanul Elder arrives too late and Harbin escapes.
events.quote: the Citanul Elder did not reach the site of trespass in time before Harbin had escaped the island

events.summary: Titania refuses Harbin's offered alliance against Mishra but lets him leave unharmed.
events.quote: Titania refused because Urza's armies despoiled the land equally as much as Mishra did

events.summary: Citanul is obliterated with Argoth when Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: Citanul was obliterated along with the rest of Argoth in the last battle of the Brothers' War

events.summary: Surviving Citanul Druids are driven mad by Argoth's fall and grow violent.
events.quote: Driven mad by the fall of Argoth, the Citanul Druids grew violent

relations.quote: Citanul was the capital of Argoth
He spoke to the queen of Citanul
